summary: James is absent from Alabama’s Thursday report; Ford and Edmonds remain questionable. Watch the active right tackle and Russell’s first decision against Georgia, and use the updated parking and stadium-entry instructions.

items.headline: James is absent from the injury report; Ford and Edmonds are questionable
items.tldr: Thursday’s SEC report retains those statuses. James’s absence from the list does not settle the starting lineup or snap count; watch the active right tackle and any help in protection.
items.outlet: Tuscaloosa News via Roll Bama Roll

items.headline: Russell threw for 285 yards and three touchdowns at Mississippi State
items.tldr: His decision-making is the useful part to carry forward. Watch him take the available receiver before trying to extend a play against Georgia.

items.headline: Griffin led Alabama with nine tackles off the bench
items.tldr: Tuesday’s national freshman award recognizes his Mississippi State performance. Watch assignment discipline along with the tackle totals.

items.headline: College GameDay is at Coleman Coliseum; stadium gates open at 4 p.m. CT
items.tldr: No Friday tailgate setup. Campus lots, shuttles and uncovered tailgating start no earlier than noon CT, with weather delays possible; check the official page before traveling.

items.headline: Georgia has used the same starting offensive line in every game
items.tldr: The opponent’s preview highlights continuity up front. Watch the pressure arrive without opening an escape lane or losing a receiver behind it.

lead.headline: Protect Russell’s first read.
lead.body: Watch the tackle hold the edge long enough for the first route to develop. Take the useful throw before trying to extend the play; keep defensive pressure connected to coverage.

matchup.question: What should Alabama emphasize against Georgia?
matchup.answer: Follow the active right tackle and help at the edge, then Russell’s decision when the first route is covered. On defense, keep the pressure coordinated so the quarterback cannot escape into an uncovered throw.
